records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Willow Media
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets, and no reply to three Wrenfield emails (email:1675ce0b, email:6a7e492b, email:036f3d33). Complete silence plus no setup activity suggests low unaided odds within the remaining 8 days, though Team plan signals real intent.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

I know a new tool is easy to put off in a busy week, so no pressure here. One thing worth knowing: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project in place is what makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything about how your team works.

Best,
Chidi
